frozen_interface.boundary: Direct single-argument parameterized Boolean assertion from changed author test, callable defined in selected production file, primitive one-step projection yields licensed separator; no new grammar, wrappers or semantic exceptions.

eligibility_rules.metadata_only: For each repository in frozen order, examine merged PRs dated 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30, sorted ascending by merge timestamp then PR number. Require both original-author test and production Python files changed and at least one changed test callable; take first qualifying PR. Metadata/file paths only before role freeze. Stop UNKNOWN if fewer than 4 candidate pairs; do not replace repositories.
eligibility_rules.role_assignment: First 3 metadata-eligible distinct repositories are sequential training native admission candidates; fourth is sealed future. No reuse of attrs, AnyIO, Trio, Werkzeug or tox / prior frozen pool.
eligibility_rules.native_admission: Run original base checkout plus exact author-head test-file overlay, compare AST new/changed Test*/test* nodes, require >=1 protected failure, >=1 executed, zero errors, zero protected skips; select first qualifying training candidate; freeze task roles and hashes before source/test bodies or native execution.
eligibility_rules.applicability: Invoke byte-identical method after admission, no target-specific modifications. A method inapplicability is a valid negative, never count as repaired.
eligibility_rules.success: Two native clean runs on selected protected cases, full author test file green, physical withdrawal reproduces protected failure, byte-identical restoration restores pass. Only then unseal future and test fixed method unchanged.
eligibility_rules.comparators: On positive prospective future only: matched-information ledger and coding agent if actually available; account all native attempts and costs.
eligibility_rules.science: G2 remains UNKNOWN until independently audited future native success and causality; do not claim generic transfer from training-only success.

seal: Do not access new PR source or tests until metadata roles frozen; no access to future source/tests until causal training qualification.
